skillsSnapshot.prompt:
The following skills provide specialized instructions for specific tasks.
Use the read tool to load a skill's file when the task matches its description.
When a skill file references a relative path, resolve it against the skill directory (parent of SKILL.md / dirname of the path) and use that absolute path in tool commands.

<available_skills>
  <skill>
    <name>browser-automation</name>
    <description>Use when controlling web pages with the OpenClaw browser tool, especially multi-step flows, login checks, tab management, or recovery from stale refs/timeouts.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/dist-runtime/extensions/browser/skills/browser-automation/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>gh-issues</name>
    <description>Fetch GitHub issues, delegate fixes to subagents, open PRs, watch reviews, or run /gh-issues workflows.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/gh-issues/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>github</name>
    <description>Use gh for GitHub issues, PR status, CI/logs, comments, reviews, releases, and API queries.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/github/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>healthcheck</name>
    <description>Audit and harden hosts running OpenClaw for SSH, firewall, updates, exposure, cron checks, and risk posture.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/healthcheck/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>node-connect</name>
    <description>Diagnose OpenClaw Android, iOS, or macOS node pairing, QR/setup code, route, auth, and connection failures.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/node-connect/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>session-logs</name>
    <description>Search and analyze your own session logs (older/parent conversations) using jq.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/session-logs/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>sherpa-onnx-tts</name>
    <description>Local text-to-speech via sherpa-onnx (offline, no cloud)</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/sherpa-onnx-tts/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>skill-creator</name>
    <description>Create, edit, improve, tidy, review, audit, or restructure AgentSkills and SKILL.md files.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>taskflow</name>
    <description>Coordinate multi-step detached tasks as one durable TaskFlow job with owner context, state, waits, and child tasks.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/taskflow/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>taskflow-inbox-triage</name>
    <description>Example TaskFlow pattern for inbox triage, intent routing, waiting on replies, and later summaries.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/taskflow-inbox-triage/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>video-frames</name>
    <description>Extract frames or short clips from videos using ffmpeg.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/video-frames/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>weather</name>
    <description>Get current weather, rain, temperature, and forecasts for locations or travel planning.</description>
    <location>~/Library/Application Support/GraculaExample/openclaw/skills/weather/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
</available_skills>
